name: Git
description: Git, laid out like GitHub Desktop: changes staged by file, hunk or line, history with a graph, branches, stashes, tags, blame, conflicts, and sync.

settings.title: Git executable
settings.description: The git to run. Empty: the one on PATH, else Git for Windows' or Homebrew's usual places.

settings.title: Default branch for new repositories
settings.description: The first branch of a repository made with Initialize repository.

settings.title: Speed up history in big repositories
settings.description: Write git's commit-graph cache when a repository with a long history has none (as git gc does), so history, the graph and branches stay fast.

settings.title: Fetch automatically
settings.description: While a Git window shows a repository, fetch its remote this often (quietly: a remote that asks for a password is skipped).

settings.title: Diff view
settings.description: How diffs are shown at first. Each Git window can switch.

settings.title: Ignore whitespace
settings.description: Leave changes of whitespace alone in diffs (lines can't be staged one by one then).

settings.title: Context lines
settings.description: Unchanged lines shown around each change.

settings.title: Sign off commits
settings.description: Add a Signed-off-by line to every commit, unless the commit box says otherwise.
